SELECT ?investorId ?compositeScore

          ((SUM(?cashFlowAmount) + SUM(?holdingGain) - AVG(?goalShortfall)) AS ?compositeScore)

      # Subquery to get investors with all three components
      {
        SELECT ?investorId
        WHERE {
          ?investor wm:investorId ?investorId .
          ?cashFlow wm:cashFlowOfInvestor ?investor ; wm:amount ?cfAmount .
          ?holding wm:heldByInvestor ?investor ; wm:cost ?hCost ; wm:currentValue ?hCurrentValue .

      ?cashFlow wm:cashFlowOfInvestor ?investor ; wm:amount ?cfAmount .

      BIND(xsd:decimal(?gShortfall) AS ?goalShortfall)
    }
    GROUP BY ?investorId
  }
}
